What's new in DuckOS 1.0.54

• DuckMessage now works over the internet, DuckOS to DuckOS — message another DuckOS by their DuckCloud email, right in the same list as your texts. Real-time, with notifications.
• Scanning a sign-in QR code (from Duck Passwords, or to sign in to DuckTask on the web) no longer calls it a 'DuckOS PC' — the sign-in reads for any device.
